senses.gloss: (b. h., √גר , v. גרר) to gather, collect. Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ top (expl. ăgartlé, Ezr. I, 9).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:3:3">Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שהוא אוֹגֵר וכ׳</he> it stores up its oil, (does not-let it trickle out), v. <cite ref="A00282"><he>אֵגוֹרִי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 39a">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>שמנו אָגוּר וכ׳</he> its oil remains stored up.—
Y. Nidd. III, beg. 50ᶜ top דם אָגוּר blood collected in one place.—Trnsf. to store up thoughts, arguments.
Sifré Deut. 16 (play on géro Deut. I, 16) זה שאוֹגֵר עליו דברים that means him who heaps arguments up against him (his opponent in litigation).

Ex. R. s. 6 אגור שא׳ דברי תורה (Var. שאִיגֵּר Pi.) he is called Agur (Prov. XXX, 1) because he collected words of the Law (stored up knowledge); Koh. R. beg. שאָגוּר בד״ת because he was stored (or girded, v. אָגַר II) with knowledge.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> end. [<cite ref="Shabbat 60a">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A00552"><he>אוגרת</he></cite> ed., v. <cite ref="A00239"><he>אָגַד</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:3">Num. R. s. 20</cite> beg. (play on <he>ויגר</he> <cite ref="Numbers 22:3">Num. XXII, 3</cite>) <he>וחן נֶאֱגָרִין לעריהם</he> and they were gathered to their towns (for defence).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:10">Tosef. Dem. I, 10</cite> <he>המוֹגִירוֹת</he> the store-keepers’ places; v. <cite ref="M00403"><he>מוֹגָרָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00405"><he>מוֹגֶרֶת</he></cite>.
